snippet.title: Launching Over It Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://s.team/a/3593180

Launching Over It is a brutally challenging platformer where you must launch a ball using slingshot-style mechanics to climb your way through nostalgic, memory-filled levels. Inspired by Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy and Golfing Over It with Alva Majo, this game will test your precision, patience, and emotional resilience.

Think launching a ball is easy? Try it yourself.

Key Features:

Fair but rage-inducing gameplay
Slingshot-style launching mechanics with pinpoint precision
Constant risk of losing all progress
References to iconic games, shows, and childhood memories
A powerful, emotional, and nostalgic ending
Perfect for streamers, speedrunners, and fans of tough indie games.

Do you have what it takes to reach the top? Available now on Steam — share your run in the comments!
